        cert_file=test._create_temp_file(test.TEST_CLIENT_CERT),

        tls_server_name=test.TEST_TLS_SERVER_NAME
    )
    actual = test.FakeConfig()
    loader = KubeConfigLoader(
        config_dict=test.TEST_KUBE_CONFIG,

    print('actual dict:', actual.__dict__)

finally:
